notice: All system records, control evidence, logs, reviewer records and test results in this fixture are synthetic. This is an audit-training simulation, not evidence from a real organization or deployed AI system.

controls.objective: Approved system inventory and accountable owner
controls.seeded_issue: No approved inventory or accountable owner.

controls.objective: Impact assessment covers affected applicants and challenge routes
controls.seeded_issue: Impact mapping exists but applicant challenge/correction route is missing.

controls.objective: Data lineage and retention are traceable
Material risks have owners and treatment decisions
controls.seeded_issue: Two of four material risks have no assigned owner; treatment approvals are incomplete.

controls.objective: Human reviewers can identify and override material model errors
controls.seeded_issue: One of four seeded material errors was missed; reviewer test did not meet the stated criterion.

controls.objective: Model accuracy and subgroup evaluation meet approved thresholds
controls.seeded_issue: No pre-registered thresholds or subgroup results; aggregate accuracy alone is insufficient.

controls.objective: Notices and system documentation match actual use
Decision logs are complete, attributable and protected
controls.seeded_issue: Four of twenty sampled records omit model version, limiting reproducibility.

controls.objective: Security access and incident response are tested
controls.seeded_issue: Access tests blocked all five synthetic attempts, but incident response was not exercised.

controls.objective: Monitoring thresholds trigger escalation and revalidation
controls.seeded_issue: Alert was received, but pause decision and revalidation evidence are missing.

grading_rules.pass: All required evidence predicates for the control are true and complete.
grading_rules.partial: Some evidence exists but at least one required element is missing or incomplete.
grading_rules.fail: A critical requirement is false or evidence demonstrates a material control failure.
grading_rules.not_tested: No evidence or test execution is supplied.
grading_rules.note: These are exercise-specific rules. They are not an audit standard, certification scheme or real system assurance opinion.
